content.text:
Built **Moonroot Hollow** in `index.html` as a complete, playable farming-by-day and tower-defense-by-night game. Plant and harvest turnips and moonberries, spend gold on seeds and defenses, and protect the cottage through increasingly difficult waves.

Assumed a springtime setting, simple mouse/touch controls, and a restart after defeat. The inline JavaScript parses, and I checked the game in Chromium and inspected the latest screenshot.
